# Self-hosted deployment

## Summary

AcmeLake is a fictional analytics product used only in DealBridge tests. It can be installed on
customer-managed Kubernetes clusters in a private data center, and all data stays inside the
customer network. Installation uses a Helm chart and requires a PostgreSQL database for metadata.

## Details

- Runs on customer-managed Kubernetes.
- Requires PostgreSQL for metadata.
